name: Tipasa
description: Tipasa sits on Algeria's Mediterranean coast, where a Punic trading post became a Roman town and a launchpad for conquering the Mauretanian kingdoms. Wandering the seaside site, you pass Phoenician, Roman, early Christian and Byzantine ruins. Nearby stands the Kbor er Roumia, a vast royal mausoleum of Mauretania built by local rulers rather than by Rome.
